_doc: Brand palette supplied by the user (swatch image). Pastel fills are used ONLY to signal status or highlight; text and data marks use the neutral ink tones so contrast stays readable. Status is never conveyed by colour alone - every status also carries a text label.

derived_for_contrast._doc: Darker tints of the brand hues, derived so that lines and text meet contrast needs on white/cream. Not part of the supplied swatch.
